checks: Current durability reads/writes the selected instance directly; same-ID swords and selection changes retain independent wear
Integration requires strictly more than 10%, charges once, isolates spirit wear and releases to the currently selected ordinary instance
Infinite mode permits zero-durability integration; refill, clamping and consumption affect only the active durability source
Ordinary destruction preserves integrated spirit; replacing equipment from a save immediately changes the active source without stale references
Repair totals missing durability across all ordinary swords, rejects insufficient money atomically, accepts exact balance and charges the stored quote even after wear changes; spirit stays unchanged
Reset clears mode, spirit and quote; original x87 without x89 still repairs at the initial zero quote, and full swords quote zero
